newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka slips as Latvian boure more active.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka slips as Latvian boure more active.

text.p: Latvian stocks were slightly more active on Thursday and Unibanka led what was rather directionless trade, losing some ground, dealers said.
"This was a normal trading session without surprises and no clear pointers for direction," one dealer said.
Total turnover came to 66,000 lats versus 47,000 lats and Rietumu index lost 0.91 percent to 184.07.
Unibanka dominated and lost ground, shedding five santimes to 3.40 lats on 21,300 lats.
Staburadze, which has been advancing steadily during previous sessions, rose another two santimes to 2.69 lats on trade of 13,900 lats.
"Good first quarter results and earlier remarks on the planned presence on other Baltic markets seem to keep up interest in the stock," one dealer said.
Transport Fleet was also in demand on turnover of 9,800 lats as it remained unchanged at 1.25 lats while Kaija cannery rose two santimes to 2.19 lats on trade of 2,300 lats.
Valmiera Glassfibre, a traditional secondary list leader lately, slipped two santimes to 1.54 lats as it saw shares worth 8,600 lats change hands.
